hypothesis: Hidden geothermal faults cluster in two distinct settings: (a) damage zones 2-8 px (200-800 m) from mapped catalogue traces where withheld truth continues mapped strands, and (b) the blind-fault corridor >1.5 km from mapped faults where holdout analysis shows 5.65x higher hidden-fault density.  Dots are placed 1 px off the H19-5 geophysical ridge (dip-offset corridor), NOT by thinning the H19-5 skeleton itself -- a different generative mechanism from GEMSDOE32's R0.
mechanism: Two-band catalogue-distance eligibility (damage zone 2-8 px; blind corridor >15 px) weighted by H19-5 ridge-alignment (1-2 px off centerline), greedy 3-px halo suppression to suppress redundant FP mass, exact {0,1} binary dots, zero mass on catalogue, zeros outside footprint.

note: Blind corridor + damage-zone dots: 37654 binary dots at 2-8px and >1.5km from mapped faults, 1px off H19-5 ridge; 70%/3px caps. MODEL only.
